summary: Probed llm_client dependency. LLMConfig (types.py) has no json_mode field — adding bool field (default False) is safe. Provider call() methods (Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI, OpenRouter) have no json_mode param — need adding. complete()/complete_with_retry() do not forward json_mode to providers — need threading. OpenRouterProvider overrides call() entirely (no super delegation) so needs its own json_mode branch. structured_llm uses config: dict[str,Any] duck-typing — propagation will use dataclasses.replace for LLMConfig instances or dict copy for plain dicts (stdlib dataclasses, no cross-module import). No contract mismatches that change phase scope.

OpenRouterProvider overrides call() fully so needs its own branch. Anthropic has no response_format API -- will use assistant prefill; asymmetry documented in D-11. Propagation strategy (dataclasses.replace vs dict copy) recorded in D-10.
